The '''Rial Kroon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], advanced versions of the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] were first spotted in this system, [[Battle of the Rial Kroon system|fighting]] against [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Toluz Cheq]].<ref name="TCW10">[[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]]</ref>
